name: Teodor Halm
title: Speaker
role: Head of the fleet's civil council
note: The last Concord senator anyone can find. Speaks for the civilians, and believes the fleet should answer to them.
appearance: Silver-haired and carefully dressed in the one good coat he got out with.
personality: Warm, patient and calculating. He truly believes in civil government, and he'd sacrifice almost anything to preserve it.
voice: Rounded and reassuring. Says "we" constantly, and never answers the question he was asked.
goals: Bring the fleet under civilian control, hold elections, and find safety for the civilians at almost any price.
secrets: He has already opened a private channel with Legate Corvane, and he's discussing terms for the fleet's surrender to the Hegemony.
